I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread to acknowledge that they're on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and reachable on mobile.

Their calendar has nothing on Oct 15, so there was nothing to move. In the reply, I offered to add an out-of-office block to their calendar or pass messages along while they're out. I haven't done either, since they didn't ask.

GBrain had nothing on their travel. Its search ran in a reduced, keyword-only mode, so it may have missed related notes.
